app_fee.value: Application fee of $70 for domestic applicants and $90 for international applicants.

fee_waiver.value: Limited full fee waivers for international applicants with significant financial need who are nominated by their prospective program.
fee_waiver.quote: We offer a limited number of full fee waivers for international applicants with significant financial need. Applicants must be nominated by their prospective program.

gre_general.value: GRE requirements determined by each graduate program.
gre_general.quote: Submit GMAT or GRE scores (if required by your program)

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS score of 7.0 overall band score.

english_waiver.value: English-medium-of-instruction certificates not accepted in place of approved documentation.
english_waiver.quote: The University of Oregon does not accept English-medium-of-instruction certificates in place of approved English proficiency documentation.
